name: disclosure-pack
title: Disclosure review pack
for_each: select id,name from cycles order by name

sections.title: Reporting dates
sections.sql: select period_end,deadline,retain_until,status from cycles where id=$1

sections.title: Narrative drafts
sections.note: Internal draft. Not issued financial statements.
sections.sql: select reference,title,narrative from items where cycle_id=$1 order by reference

sections.title: Supporting figures
sections.sql: select code,label,value::text value,unit,evidence_ref,observed_on from facts where cycle_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Review checks
sections.sql: select reference,revision,signed_revision,evidence_gaps,failed_tieouts,open_tasks,coalesce(is_signed,false) signed from v_reporting where cycle_id=$1 order by reference

name: signoff-record
title: Disclosure sign-off record
for_each: select id,reference name from items order by reference

sections.title: Disclosure
sections.sql: select reference,title,owner,narrative,revision from items where id=$1

sections.title: Decision history
sections.note: Operator-supplied reviewer labels. No digital signature.
sections.sql: select revision,decision,actor,evidence_ref,created_at from signoffs where item_id=$1 order by created_at

name: reconciliation
title: Reporting reconciliation record
for_each: select id,name from cycles order by name

sections.title: Agreements and differences
sections.sql: select name,left_code,right_code,left_value,right_value,difference,unit,tolerance,passed from v_tieouts where cycle_id=$1 order by name
